title: How the biological clock regulates phases of wakefulness
summary: The circadian clock is an internal biological system that regulates sleep-wake cycles, as well as many physiological functions such as body temperature and hormone production. In many animals, this clock relies on a network of neurons that generates rhythms of approximately 24 hours.

title: The ocean as a medicine cabinet: Researchers search for useful microbes
summary: New medicines, crop protection products and treatments for fish diseases could have their origins on the seabed. title: Learning math goes (slightly) better with AI, but human teacher plays a key role
summary: Elementary school students who use an AI-supported learning tool learn arithmetic more quickly than children who do not use such a tool. This is the finding of a multiyear study by Radboud University involving nearly 8,000 children. However, the researchers warn that it's no miracle cure, as the teacher's role remains essential even with AI.
